// Puzzle data for Defuse, the daily wire-cutting logic puzzle (owner,
// 2026-11-12). Imported ONLY by the server page (app/defuse/page.js), which
// filters live<=today before handing puzzles to the client, so future boards
// never reach a browser.
//
// GENERATED by scripts/gen-defuse.mjs, deterministically off each date. Never
// hand-edit a board, and never regenerate one that has gone live: the generator
// may only append days. scripts/verify-defuse.mjs re-proves every board with
// the engine the game itself runs (lib/defuse-engine.js).
//
// THE GAME. A device with a row of colored wires, a serial number, a battery
// count and one indicator light, and a manual of rules. Every wire is cut
// unless a rule protects it, and exactly ONE order of cuts obeys every rule.
// The player taps wires in that order. One wrong cut ends the day: a solve
// scores 10, anything else 0, and the clock ranks the solvers.
//
// EVERY BOARD (proved by the verifier): exactly one safe order; every rule
// whose condition is true is needed (drop it and a second safe order appears);
// every decoy's condition is false on that device; at least three wires are
// cut; the safe order is never simply left to right or right to left.
//
// THE WEEKLY RAMP (no Sunday Edition flag: Sunday is the week's biggest board):
//   Mon, Tue  tier Gentle    4 wires, 3 live rules, no decoys
//   Wed, Thu  tier Moderate  5 wires, 4 live rules, 1 decoy
//   Fri, Sat  tier Tough     6 wires, 5 live rules, 1 or 2 decoys
//   Sunday    tier Tough     7 wires, 5 or 6 live rules, 2 decoys
// On Gentle and Moderate days every wrong cut breaks a rule on the spot
// (`lookAhead: false`), so the board can be solved one cut at a time. On Tough
// days a cut can break nothing outright and still leave no safe way to finish
// (`lookAhead: true`), so the order has to be planned.
//
// Fields: wires (colors, left to right), serial, batteries, light { label,
// on }, rules (see lib/defuse-engine.js for the rule shapes), solution (wire
// indexes, 0-based, in cutting order), active (how many rules have a true
// condition), lookAhead.
